record.question: All Indian politicians, except for Indira Gandhi, are corrupt. From which of the following can the statement above be most properly inferred?
options: Except for Indira Gandhi, if someone is a corrupt politicians, then he or she is Indian.
If an Indian is corrupt, then he or she is a politician, as long as he or she is not Indira Gandhi.
Aside from Indira Gandhi, if someone is an Indian politician, then he or she is corrupt.
Indira Gandhi is the only non-Indian politicians who is corrupt.
